verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile SSH/Mosh terminal. Built-in AI agent features are a fair axis for terminal products, so this story applies. However, the evidence documents no conversational agent that can browse, search, edit, commit, pull, or push in a repository. It covers only SSH/Mosh connectivity, local shell utilities, and VS Code/Codespaces connections, which are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
